rows.en: Too soft! Subjugate!
The whole galaxy is a beautiful nebula… and above all, Earth is the opal of the solar system! Behold…
Beautiful… I like it, Priest Poe!

I wish to present this beautiful opal to Your Majesty while it still shines!

Come forth, children of battle!
The Five Kunoichi! Gal One!
Gal Two!
Gal Three!
Gal Four!
Gal Five!
Sha, sha, sha…
Then I, Hessler, shall lead these ones and go seize the Earth by force.

Your Majesty… we must not take the Earth by brute force!

We shall paint human hearts black and turn them into devils! I beg you, a Fushigi Beast…

Your Majesty… grant the life of a Fushigi Beast to our mother, the Fushigi Sea.
O sea… O mother Fushigi Sea! Bless us with the life of a Fushigi Beast.
Kyuuu-ih!!
This is an other-dimensional space. Here, cut off from all phenomena, stood Makuu's stronghold, Makai Castle.

Hunter Killer…

Use the bio-fusion device to fuse Doubleman with a Monster and create a Double Monster!
A Double Monster?

Yes…

Fuse Doubleman's intellect with a Monster's power to make a Double Monster! Go, crush Gavan!!
A new Space Sheriff?

That's right… According to Retsu, they arrived on Earth sometime last night.

But listen… they may be rookies, but don't take them lightly. After all, they were drilled hard at that Space Sheriff Training Academy.
"They"… So there's more than one new Space Sheriff?
"They"… So there's more than one new Space Sheriff?
Oh… I don't know the details, but I hear one of them is a woman.
A female Space Sheriff, huh…

Even so, yet another new evil organization has shown up?

The greatest and mightiest invader in the dark universe… We can't let our guard down…

…!?

W-who's there?
What's wrong, Takeshi? Is somebody there?
Oyassan, somebody left this in front of the shop…
I won't forgive this… Gel-Shocker, General Black!
Hey, Takeshi! Where are you going? Hey!
Hongo must be really hurting… I get how he feels, but…
The way he tries not to show it only makes it look more painful.
I hope Hayato is all right…
I'm heading out for a bit… I'm counting on you to mind the shop.

Even so, yet another new evil organization has shown up?

The greatest and mightiest invader in the dark universe… We can't afford to let our guard down…
Hongo must be really hurting, huh? I understand how he feels, but…
The way he tries not to show it is kind of touching…
I hope Hayato is all right…
The Fushigi Song is ready.
Your Majesty, what shall we do?
We must delay no longer! Turn them into beasts!
Fushigi Song, stand by!!
OK!
Fushigi Song, start!!
Fufufu… Commence the invasion of Earth! Subjugate!!

Hayato… Are you really dead?

I talk tough in front of everyone, but I… I feel like I'm losing the strength to do anything at all.

What am I supposed to hold on to in my heart to keep fighting evil? …Rest in peace.
Strange music is coming out of TVs and radios, and the people who hear it are turning violent one after another!
A Fushigi Song!? No doubt about it, that's Fuuma's Fushigi Song! Their invasion of Earth has finally begun.
All right… Let's see what these Fuuma guys can do, shall we!?
Then… shall we go see what these Fuuma people can do!?

Take care, Hayato… I'll always be watching over you! No matter how far apart we are!

…!?

But… what is this music?
Hongo, it's a signal hijack!! We have to trace the pirate broadcast and pin down the station…
Right, got it! Let's split up and search!

Captain Gavan!! I have just arrived on Earth!

Makuu, Fuuma!! I won't let you do as you please! Shoketsu!!
Nngh… Subjugate!
Space Sheriff Shaider!!
Transformation announcement

So you're the new Space Sheriff?

But… what's this "Captain" business?

So you're the new Space Sheriff?

But… what's this "Captain" business?
We can talk later… First, I'll destroy the pirate broadcast station! Shaider Scope!!

There it is!

Video Beam Gun!!
The broadcast station is destroyed! Now the people will be saved.
Curse you, Space Sheriff Shaider! Come forth! Fushigi Beast Baribari, Gal Corps! Subjugate!
Kyuuu-ih, kyuuu-ih!!
Fushigi Dimension…
Fushigi Dimension, generate!!
Are you really going to leave just like this?

Yeah… It's not like we're parting forever, and a new mission starts for me now!

Hongo, I won't lose to you! Look forward to what I'll do from here on.
Gel-Shocker in South America is tough!
Leave it to me… More importantly, I'm counting on you to look after Japan!
Yeah… I'll take it on.
This camera… I've only got the one, but I'll leave it as a keepsake. Give it to everyone…
Got it…
What!? We've only just fought Fuuma, and now there's another new space crime organization?

Yes, and that's why… I've decided to send more Space Sheriffs to the Earth sector.

Let me introduce them… joining you two in charge of the Earth sector: Space Sheriff Sharivan and Lily!
Ah… But this is great! We've got even more comrades now.
But I hear Fuuma isn't the only evil organization targeting Earth! Personal revenge is strictly off-limits.

Yeah…

But Commander Kom… I'm the one originally in charge of the Earth sector! Me, Gavan! Sending us this many Space Sheriffs…
That's right… He's Captain Gavan!!

Ah, r-right… Captain, huh?

I'm counting on you, Sharivan, Shaider!!

uncertain: U03130/U03174/U03184/U03192: Hessler's catchphrase 征伐 rendered 'Subjugate!'.
U03133: 戦いの嬰冗 unclear; read as 嬰児 and rendered 'children of battle'.
U03134: くの一・五人衆 rendered 'The Five Kunoichi'.
U03176: continuation row of an unseen speaker's line; translated as reported speech.
U03186: へんしんアナウンス looks like a leftover placeholder; rendered literally as 'Transformation announcement'.
U03207: trailing sentence left unfinished as in the source.
omissions_kept: U03176: speaker not shown on this continuation row

new_names.why: following 不思議獣バリバリ
